rules.title: Fixed Admission Period
rules.description: Candidates have to complete admission formalities within a fixed period of time as decided by the admission committee. Failure to do so will warrant automatic cancellation.

rules.title: Class Attendance Requirement
rules.description: Any student failing to attend class within two weeks of commencement will warrant cancellation of admission and forfeiture of all fees, including security deposit.

rules.title: Waiting List Policy
rules.description: Waiting lists will be prepared and displayed by the admission committee as per merit and be notified as per requirements.

rules.title: Department Allotment
rules.description: Departments will be allotted based on merit position in the admission test at the end of admission. Individual choices will be given preference as far as possible.

required_documents.heading: Required Documents
documents: 3 copies of recent passport size colored photos (attested)
Character certificate from the last institute

quota_documents.detail: Original Freedom Fighter certificate of parents issued by the Ministry of FF Affairs.
Original certificate issued by local UP chairman and countersigned by DC.
Certificate of authenticity issued by respective commanding officers/Record Office.

medical_checkup.heading: Medical Check-up
medical_checkup.description: All provisionally selected candidates must undergo a medical check-up at the BAUST medical center.
medical_checkup.warning: The medical authority will decide on the final physical fitness of candidates for admission.

guardian_consent.heading: Guardian's Consent
guardian_consent.description: Both candidates and their parents/guardians must render a consent certificate accepting terms and conditions formulated by BAUST.
